# posts.publish — POST /posts/{id}/publish

Publish a post

Sets `publishedAt` to the current time. Only the author may publish, otherwise 403. Publishing an already published post keeps the original `publishedAt`.

## Call
```ts
const res = await user.posts.publish({ path: { id: "0" } })
res.assert(200)
```

## Input
```ts
{ path: {
  /** Post id. */
  "id": string
} }
```

## Responses
```ts
200: PostDto
401: ErrorDto // Missing or invalid bearer token.
403: ErrorDto // The current user is not the author.
404: ErrorDto // No post with this id.
```

## Types
```ts
type PostDto = {
  /** Post id. */
  "id": number
  /** Post title. */
  "title": string
  /** Post body. */
  "content": string
  /** Id of the user who created the post. */
  "authorId": number
  /** When the post was published. `null` while the post is a draft. */
  "publishedAt": string | null
  /** When the post was created. */
  "createdAt": string
}
type ErrorDto = {
  /** HTTP status code. */
  "statusCode": number
  /** Error message. Validation errors (400) return a list: one message per failed constraint. */
  "message": string | Array<string>
  /** HTTP status text, e.g. "Not Found". */
  "error"?: string
}
```
